<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<head>
    <!-- 页面通用 header 配置 -->
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
</head>

<body>

</body>
<script src="https://www.pubgmobile.com/sgp/milo-next/long_cache_30d/milo.es5.js"></script>
<script>
    var checkip = function () {
        try {
            var lalanguage = !!navigator.language
            if (lalanguage) {
                if (navigator.language.slice(0, 2) === "pt") {
                    window.location.href = "/pt/flash/";
                } else if (navigator.language.slice(0, 2) === "es") {
                    window.location.href = "/es/flash/";
                } else {
                    Milo.setCommonConfig({
                        needPromiseCallback: false,
                        activityApi: "https://webide.amsoveasea.com/amside/page/12_4riNOt",
                        ideApi: "https://webide.amsoveasea.com/ide/"
                    });

                    var flow = {
                        actId: '12_4riNOt',
                        token: '8PQBoe',
                        loading: false, // 开启loading浮层,默认开启
                        sData: {},
                        success: function (res) {
                            result = res.details.jData
                            switch (result.country.toLocaleLowerCase()) {
                                case 'th':
                                    window.location.href = "/th/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'es':
                                    window.location.href = "/es/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'mx':
                                    window.location.href = "/es/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'fr':
                                    window.location.href = "/fr/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'tr':
                                    window.location.href = "/tr/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'vn':
                                    window.location.href = "/vi/flash/";
                                    break
                                case 'de':
                                    window.location.href = "/de/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'id':
                                    window.location.href = "/id/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'pt':
                                    window.location.href = "/pt/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'ru':
                                    window.location.href = "/ru/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'hk':
                                    window.location.href = "/HK/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'tw':
                                    window.location.href = "/TW/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'sa':
                                    window.location.href = "/ar/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'ae':
                                    window.location.href = "/ar/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'eg':
                                    window.location.href = "/ar/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'qa':
                                    window.location.href = "/ar/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'kw':
                                    window.location.href = "/ar/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'lb':
                                    window.location.href = "/ar/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'om':
                                    window.location.href = "/ar/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'iq':
                                    window.location.href = "/ar/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'jo':
                                    window.location.href = "/ar/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'dz':
                                    window.location.href = "/ar/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'ps':
                                    window.location.href = "/ar/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'bh':
                                    window.location.href = "/ar/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'ly':
                                    window.location.href = "/ar/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'ma':
                                    window.location.href = "/ar/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'tn':
                                    window.location.href = "/ar/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'ye':
                                    window.location.href = "/ar/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'pk':
                                    window.location.href = "/uz/flash/";
                                    break;
                                case 'my':
                                    window.location.href = "/my/flash/";
                                    break;
                                default:
                                    window.location.href = "/en/flash/";
                            }
                        },
                        fail: function (res) {
                            console.log(res)
                        }
                    }
                    Milo.emit(flow)
                }
            } else {
                window.location.href = "/en/flash/";
            }
        } catch (error) {
            window.location.href = "/en/flash/";
        }
    }

    // ===== 小包预约拍脸时间窗口控制（按北京时间 UTC+8 计算） =====
    // 2026-11-13 09:00:00 ~ 2026-11-20 23:59:59（北京时间）：
    //   拍小包拍脸（走下方 checkip）
    // 其余时间：跳过拍脸，直接跳 /home.shtml，由其原有逻辑进官网首页
    // 时间来源参考 src/i18n/js/bannerConfig.js：AMS 接口获取服务器时间 unixTimeStamp
    // 北京时间 2026-11-13 09:00:00 = UTC 2026-11-13T01:00:00Z
    // 北京时间 2026-11-20 23:59:59 = UTC 2026-11-20T15:59:59Z
    var FACE_START = Date.parse("2026-11-13T01:00:00Z") / 1000;
    var FACE_END = Date.parse("2026-11-20T15:59:59Z") / 1000;

    var goByTime = function (now) {
        if (now >= FACE_START && now <= FACE_END) {
            // 拍脸窗口期（北京时间 11.13 09:00 ~ 11.20 23:59:59）：小包预约拍脸
            checkip();
        } else {
            // 其余时间：直接跳 home.shtml，由其原有逻辑进官网首页
            window.location.href = "/home.shtml";
        }
    }

    try {
        Milo.setCommonConfig({
            needPromiseCallback: false,
            activityApi: "https://webide.amsoveasea.com/amside/page/67_agNlUL",
            ideApi: "https://webide.amsoveasea.com/ide/"
        });
        Milo.emit({
            actId: "67_agNlUL",
            token: "lHQgsb",
            loading: false, // 开启loading浮层,默认开启
            sData: {
                sign: "c39bb729765ebd2dc9acb9d53eac1d63"
            },
            success: function (res) {
                goByTime(res.details.jData.unixTimeStamp);
            },
            fail: function (res) {
                console.log("time api fail, goto home", res);
                // 接口失败：直接进官网首页
                window.location.href = "/home.shtml";
            }
        });
    } catch (error) {
        console.log("time api error, goto home", error);
        // 异常：直接进官网首页
        window.location.href = "/home.shtml";
    }
</script>

</html>
